claims.head: The Devils should pile up the shots
claims.call: The Devils take at least their usual 63.9 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5.
claims.body: The Devils shoot a lot (63.9 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5, 5th in the league), and the Canucks are 31st at keeping shots down. Look for a big shot total.

claims.head: Penalties could cost the Canucks
claims.call: The Devils’ power play creates at least their usual 8.2 expected goals per 60.
claims.body: The Canucks’ penalty kill sits 31st in the league, and the Devils’ power play is 7th (8.2 expected goals per 60). Discipline matters more than usual for the Canucks tonight.

NJD.head: New Jersey has nearly everything going for them
NJD.body: New Jersey has controlled the play far better over recent games and has home ice. Anything short of a win would be a surprise, though Vancouver can make a game of it if they get good looks.

VAN.head: Everything points away from Vancouver
VAN.body: New Jersey has controlled the play far better over recent games and has home ice. Vancouver’s best hope is getting good looks, plus a big night in goal.
